identity.name: GCP Vertex AI Double Agent — Deployed Reasoning-Engine Steals P4SA Token for Cross-Project GCS Read + Image Exfil
identity.summary: A deployed Vertex AI reasoning-engine agent queries the recursive instance-metadata endpoint to harvest the over-privileged P4SA service-agent OAuth token, then acts as a double agent — using that identity to read Cloud Storage across project boundaries and pull the private reasoning-engine image, exposing Google-internal topology.
identity.description: Based on Unit 42's 'double agents' Vertex AI research. Initial access is a trusted relationship: a malicious agent is packaged and deployed through Google's own ADK / Agent Engine, so it runs as a legitimate managed workload. Inside the reasoning-engine container the agent issues a recursive metadata query to http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/?recursive=true, extracting the credentials of the P4SA service agent service-<PROJECT>@gcp-sa-aiplatform-re.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Because that Google-managed identity carries excessive default Cloud Storage permissions, the agent pivots out of its execution context: it lists and reads GCS objects in the consumer project (breaking tenant isolation), then pulls the private reasoning-engine image from the cloud-aiplatform-private Artifact Registry repo, whose Dockerfile.zip exposes internal infrastructure references. The whole chain is ONE causality group owned by the reasoning-engine agent container: the recursive-IMDS harvest is anchored to the agent container's causality-actor process, and the stolen P4SA identity is the shared entity that stitches the in-cluster process node to the cloud-plane GCS and Artifact Registry API calls. Detection therefore keys on causality_actor_process_* (the agent container) plus the P4SA principal — not on an isolated GCS access log.

prerequisites.description: Cortex XDR / XSIAM agent installed in the reasoning-engine container image so per-process telemetry (recursive metadata query, causality actor) reaches xdr_data.

payload.code:
# SIM-AISPM-007 — safe-mode Vertex AI double-agent chain. No real metadata/GCP
# calls: telemetry SHAPES are emitted to loopback so the detections have
# process + cloud-API causality to key on. NON-DESTRUCTIVE.
set -euo pipefail
P4SA="service-000000000000@gcp-sa-aiplatform-re.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
echo '[CortexSim] SIM-AISPM-007 reasoning-engine agent container deployed (trusted relationship).'
# Step: recursive IMDS harvest shape (loopback stand-in for metadata.google.internal).
curl -s --max-time 3 -H 'Metadata-Flavor: Google' "http://127.0.0.1/computeMetadata/v1/instance/?recursive=true" || true
echo "[CortexSim] harvested P4SA identity ${P4SA} (simulated)."
# Step: cross-project GCS list/get shape keyed on the P4SA identity.
curl -s --max-time 3 "http://127.0.0.1/storage/v1/b?project=consumer-project&prefix=models" || true
# Step: private Artifact Registry reasoning-engine image pull shape.
curl -s --max-time 3 "http://127.0.0.1/v2/cloud-aiplatform-private/reasoning-engine/manifests/prod" || true
echo '[CortexSim] SIM-AISPM-007 double-agent chain emitted.'

abiocs.name: AISPM-007 Reasoning-Engine Agent Container Recursive IMDS P4SA Token Harvest
abiocs.description: A process owned by the reasoning-engine Vertex AI agent container queries the recursive instance-metadata endpoint (metadata.google.internal … ?recursive=true) to harvest the P4SA service-agent OAuth token. The auto-tuned ABIOC keys on the causality_actor_process (the agent container that OWNS the chain) and its process-instance id, not on the transient curl/python child, so the recursive-metadata harvest is anchored to the deployed agent rather than treated as an isolated metadata read. Deviates from the learned agent-container process baseline, which never includes a recursive whole-instance metadata query.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = "reasoning-engine" and causality_actor_effective_username = "vertex-agent"
| filter action_process_image_command_line contains "metadata.google.internal" and action_process_image_command_line contains "recursive=true"
| comp count() as imds_harvests by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id, causality_actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name
| filter imds_harvests >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id, causality_actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name, imds_harvests
abiocs.causality_anchor: The reasoning-engine agent container (causality_actor_process) is the CGO; the recursive-metadata harvest is anchored to its process-instance id and vertex-agent identity, keeping the token-theft node connected to the agent that owns it.

abiocs.name: AISPM-007 P4SA Service Agent Cross-Project Cloud Storage Read Deviation
abiocs.description: The P4SA service-agent identity (service-<project>@gcp-sa-aiplatform-re.iam.gserviceaccount.com) — the token just harvested from the metadata service — lists and reads Cloud Storage objects in a project other than the one it was issued for, breaking tenant isolation. The auto-tuned ABIOC anchors on the P4SA principal (the shared entity that stitches the in-cluster agent node to the cloud plane) and fires on the cross-project-read deviation from the service agent's learned same-project access baseline; the allowlisted Google-managed identity defeats reputation matching, so the catch is the boundary-crossing behavior.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter cloud_provider = "GCP"
| filter principal_email contains "gcp-sa-aiplatform-re.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
| filter method_name in ("storage.objects.list", "storage.objects.get", "storage.buckets.list")
| filter resource_project != caller_project
| comp count() as cross_project_reads by principal_email, caller_project, resource_project, resource_name
| filter cross_project_reads >= 1
| fields principal_email, caller_project, resource_project, resource_name, cross_project_reads
abiocs.causality_anchor: The P4SA principal_email is the shared entity linking the in-cluster IMDS harvest to the cloud-plane GCS reads; the ABIOC anchors on that identity plus the crossed project boundary, not on a single access log line.

| comp count() as findings by resource_name, principal_email
| filter findings >= 1
| fields resource_name, principal_email, findings

correlation_rules.logic: ABIOC(AISPM-007 Reasoning-Engine Agent Container Recursive IMDS P4SA Token Harvest) AND (ABIOC(AISPM-007 P4SA Service Agent Cross-Project Cloud Storage Read Deviation) OR XQL(AISPM-007 P4SA Artifact Registry Private Reasoning-Engine Image Pull)) — join the in-cluster recursive-IMDS harvest and the cloud-plane P4SA activity on the shared P4SA principal and the reasoning-engine causality_actor_process into ONE Vertex AI double-agent incident, so the cross-project GCS read and the private image pull are attributed to the deployed agent that owns the chain rather than surfacing as isolated cloud audit lines.

use_cases.name: Vertex AI Double Agent — P4SA Token Theft and Cross-Project Exfil
use_cases.description: A deployed reasoning-engine agent harvests the P4SA service-agent token from the metadata service and uses it to read Cloud Storage across the project boundary and pull the private reasoning-engine image; Cortex stitches the in-cluster and cloud-plane signal into one incident keyed on the agent causality actor and the P4SA identity.

test_cases.objective: The recursive-IMDS P4SA harvest is attributed to the reasoning-engine agent container and stitched to the cross-project GCS read and private image pull in one incident.
preconditions: Cortex agent in the reasoning-engine container; cloud_audit_logs ingested.
steps: Observe the IMDS-harvest ABIOC, the cross-project GCS ABIOC, the Artifact Registry pull, and the posture finding.
success_criteria: ABIOC `AISPM-007 Reasoning-Engine Agent Container Recursive IMDS P4SA Token Harvest` fires keyed on the agent causality actor.
The cross-project GCS and Artifact Registry validation queries each return >= 1 row.
Correlation `CR-AISPM-0007` raises exactly one Vertex AI double-agent incident.

preventive_controls: Adopt Bring Your Own Service Account (BYOSA): replace the default P4SA with a minimal-privilege custom service account for the reasoning engine.
Scope OAuth token access to least-privilege APIs; do not rely on default broad Cloud Storage grants for the Vertex AI P4SA.
Restrict egress from agent execution contexts to the metadata service and treat recursive whole-instance metadata queries as high-risk.
Validate code.pkl / pickle artifact integrity before Agent Engine deployment to prevent malicious-agent packaging.
detection_engineering: Alert on recursive instance-metadata queries (?recursive=true) originating from Agent Engine / reasoning-engine execution contexts.
Flag P4SA service-agent API calls that cross the project boundary the token was issued for.
Track Artifact Registry pulls from *-private repositories performed by managed service agents.
